newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Refripar still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Refripar still a buy.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it maintained its intermediate-term buy rating for Brazilian home appliance maker Refripar.
-- It said the outlook for the remainder of 1996 and for 1997 is "bright" despite the firm's poor results in the second quarter.
-- Analyst Thomas Mello Souza said Refripar reported earnings per ADR of $0.33 for the second quarter, against an estimate of $0.52 and $0.34 year over year.
-- Souza reduced his 1996 earnings estimate per ADR, excluding unusual items, to $1.61 from $1.71.
-- He said strong cash generation coupled with conservative capital expenditure requirements for fiscal 1996 helped to reduce short-term debt by 30 percent.
-- Refripar preferred closed at 2.57 reais Friday.
